text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Hold your head high!
I saw all your hard work with my own two eyes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like it's my time to shine!
Hey, Trainy, mind lending me some change?!
choice_data_list: Um, I don't have any money left on me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh... Is that so? Then I guess I'll whip up some of my special home cooking for the newcomers.
It ended in a disappointing result...
